purpose: Stress that a particular circumstance makes a result especially strong.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Plain clause / N / な-adjectiveな + だけに
Because I had been looking forward to it, the cancellation is especially disappointing.
As a specialist, her explanation is especially precise.
Because my family lives far away, I worry especially when there is no contact.
formation: Plain clause / N / な-adjectiveな + だけに
restrictions: The fact provides an especially relevant reason or expectation.
mistake: Do not confuse this causal use with “only”.
